name: opensafari-mcp
description: iOS Safari automation MCP server via Xcode Simulator + WebKit Remote Debugging Protocol

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:src && npm run build:cli && npm run build:ax-bridge-native && npm run build:ax-bridge-cli && npm run build:sim-hid-bridge-native && npm run build:sim-hid-bridge-cli && npm run build:cursor-monitor
scripts.postbuild: cp src/native/ax-bridge.swift dist/ 2>/dev/null || true; cp src/native/sim-hid-bridge.swift dist/ 2>/dev/null || true; cp src/native/cursor-monitor.swift dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:ax-bridge-native: swiftc -O src/native/ax-bridge.swift -o dist/ax-bridge-native && (codesign --sign - dist/ax-bridge-native || echo 'ax-bridge-native: ad-hoc codesign failed, keeping unsigned binary (still runnable for AX queries against booted simulators)') || echo 'ax-bridge-native: swiftc compilation failed, falling back to swift interpreter at runtime'
scripts.build:sim-hid-bridge-native: swiftc -O src/native/sim-hid-bridge.swift -o dist/sim-hid-bridge-native && (codesign --sign - dist/sim-hid-bridge-native || echo 'sim-hid-bridge-native: ad-hoc codesign failed, keeping unsigned binary (still runnable for HID dispatch)') || echo 'sim-hid-bridge-native: swiftc compilation failed, falling back to swift interpreter at runtime'
scripts.build:cursor-monitor: swiftc -O src/native/cursor-monitor.swift -o dist/cursor-monitor && (codesign --sign - dist/cursor-monitor || echo 'cursor-monitor: ad-hoc codesign failed, keeping unsigned binary') || echo 'cursor-monitor: swiftc compilation failed, falling back to swift interpreter at runtime'
scripts.test:live: OSF_LIVE=1 node scripts/run-with-cursor-monitor.js -- npm run test:integration
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run audit:prod && npm run build && npm test
